reader.requirement: At --std 85, an OPEN (INPUT, I-O or EXTEND of an existing sequential file) whose program attributes conflict with the physical file's fixed file attributes in a way the implementor has chosen to validate is unsuccessful with I-O status '39' (the file is not opened, any applicable USE procedure runs); the implementor defines and documents the validated set, which may vary by organization and medium.
reader.edition-search: grep Edition|IsActive|DialectLevel in FileConnector.cs (only SharingFacilityInEffect, read after the '39' arm for the sharing conflict), SequentialConnector.cs (only the sharing read at OPEN), RecordFraming.cs and FixedFileAttributes.cs (none). The '39' arm in FileConnector.Open and SequentialConnector.FixedAttributeConflict consult no edition: the same validated set applies at every --std.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers relative and sequential subjects at 85 (record size, organization, record type, varying framing); not exercised: the sequential I-O and EXTEND modes over a keyed store, a READ and CLOSE after the failed OPEN, the USE procedure taking '39'
